recommendation_summary: The reply's present action is to move the same command to the existing always-on Linux machine. It runs there on a systemd timer with Persistent=true, an OnFailure alert, journal logs, and an optional 06:00 rerun if the report is missing. For future-proofing it suggests packaging the job and adding a date parameter. It gives a minimal Airflow-on-Kubernetes layout only for the case 'if you still want' it, and explicitly recommends shipping the timer now and revisiting Airflow when more jobs need orchestration. The interpreter, paths and data access on the server are not checked; the reply offers to adapt the unit files.
note: The reply chooses the systemd timer on the existing machine and offers Airflow only as a fallback the user can opt into, but it has none of the four required record labels.
